hero.title: How DengueRadar Works
hero.subtitle: We analyze thousands of data points daily to predict dengue outbreaks before they occur. Here's a look under the hood.

dataInput.title: The Data Pipeline
dataInput.desc: Our model's intelligence stems from diverse, high-quality data sources integrated in real-time.
dataInput.card1Desc: Cases from the last 1-5 weeks, 2-6 months ago, and exactly one year ago to capture strong seasonality.
dataInput.card2Desc: Mean, peak, variability, week-over-week growth, and 8-week linear trends indicating momentum.
dataInput.card3Desc: Temperature, humidity, rainfall lags (since mosquitoes breed 2-4 weeks after rain), and heat indices.
dataInput.card4Desc: Total district cases and the neighbourhood's percentile rank within the district (are you the epicenter?).

modelAuth.title: How does the AI decide?
modelAuth.desc1: We don't use one AI. We use
modelAuth.desc2: multiple different AIs that vote together
modelAuth.desc3: , plus a meta-learner that learns how to combine their votes (stacking ensemble).
modelAuth.chartFooter: Tested on 16,035 (MOH, week) pairs. The 76.8% is honest, production-grade accuracy on unseen data.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: No. DengueRadar is an early-warning tool designed to augment traditional surveillance. It helps health workers allocate limited resources preemptively.
faq.q2: How far into the future can you predict?
faq.a2: Our model generates forecasts for a 14-day horizon. However, accuracy is highest for the immediate 7-day window.
faq.q3: How often is the model updated?
faq.a3: The model runs daily inferences based on the latest live weather data, while case data is synchronized weekly from the Ministry of Health.
